content.text: block H/K ATPase (proton pump) of parietal cell, reducing acid secretion
Assoc w/ faster sxs relief & heal
most effective drug to tx PUD
•90% heal of duodenal ulcers after 4wks & gastric ulcers after 6wks
: assoc w/ C. diff infections & hip fractures
→ increases levels of theophylline, warfarin, phenytoin
MOA: prodrug: med -> active metabolite in gastric mucosa -> covalent disulfide link w proton pump enzyme (H/K/ATPase)
Prodrug, Acid unstable -Require acidic enviro to absorb:
Irreversible -Need to synth new proton pumps to reverse effects
Clin Use: ⍉ PRN, days for full effect
Prevent gastric acid secrete for extended time
Duration: short, 24-48hr =1 dose -> inhibit acid for 1-2D
↑bone frx risk (hip, wrist, spine) -↑dose or +1yr use
Drugs that need acid to absorb
Pt Ed: can be taken w/o meals
